French students blockade schools nationwide to demand more resources Copy/paste the link below: Copy Copy/paste the article video embed link below: Copy Updated: 29/09/2026 - 18:06 GMT+2 Hundreds of secondary school students blocked school entrances in Rennes and Paris during a national day of action, calling for more staff and funding for education. … More Hundreds of students took part in protests in Rennes and Paris, blocking school entrances and demanding more resources for education. ADVERTISEMENT ADVERTISEMENT In Rennes, students barricaded the entrance to Lycée Bréquigny, where bins were set alight and police faced protesters. In Paris, students at Lycée Simone Weil used bins and crates to block an entrance and called for more staff and funding, citing overcrowded classrooms and poor conditions in some schools. Students in several other parts of France also joined the national day of action.
